title: Beyond RAG for Cyber Threat Intelligence: A Systematic Evaluation of Graph-Based and Agentic Retrieval
authors: Dzenan Hamzic; Florian Skopik; Max Landauer; Markus Wurzenberger; Andreas Rauber
why_relevant: Compares RAG architectures in CTI domain and examines failure modes like unsafe abstention on unanswerable queries and overconfidence with missing evidence, touching on robustness/calibration aspects.
why_not_or_caveat: Primarily a domain-specific architectural comparison rather than a study of robustness phenomena; robustness/abstention analysis is secondary.
